_note: Viking danger in Burgundy (Event Delivery Scripts, 'Viking danger in Burgundy 886–911'). Chance is per season; camp marks the seasons an army winters in the region. If the Duke-rank player had them sent elsewhere in 886 every band drops to spared.

bands.what: The army sent from Paris winters in Burgundy, besieges Sens, ravages the Yonne valley
A band sacks Bèze abbey near Dijon; beaten near Saint-Florentin
Quiet in Burgundy; raiding continues elsewhere
Vikings winter between Tonnerre and Montbard; beaten at Argenteuil-sur-Armançon and Saint-Florentin
Quiet locally; the last campaign is at Chartres in 911

callText: Smoke on the river road, my lord. A band of Northmen from the camp is coming up the valley, on foot and mounted, and they are not foraging this time: they mean the villa.
